integrity: Exact simplicial enumeration and complete acyclicity certificates; an independently coded independence-polynomial recurrence checks face counts and Euler characteristics. No independent scientific audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Proven for the classical 24-vertex cubic permutahedral graph; no assertion for higher permutahedra. Fully exhaustive finite certificate, not a general family proof. Equivalent unindexed publications remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Vertex-uniform independence-complex splitting for the truncated octahedron
